catalog_label: Poincare duality / homological duality for manifolds
excluded_substitutions: Poincare-Lefschetz, Alexander, Serre, or Verdier duality
a finite-dimensional vector-space dimension equality instead of the cap-product isomorphism
an unconstrained Homology/Cohomology family or proposition field that assumes or stores the desired conclusion
the legacy AwesomeTheorems.Stage1.S1_M_107.StatementShape as the canonical target
formal_system: Lean 4 plus pinned mathlib, pending exact target selection

source_selection.candidate_primary_source: Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology (2002), Theorem 3.30, page 241
source_selection.candidate_statement: For a closed R-orientable n-manifold M with fundamental class [M], capping with [M] induces H^k(M; R) to H_(n-k)(M; R) isomorphisms for all k.
source_selection.identity_assessment: The catalog does not select the coefficient system, orientability encoding, compactness and boundary variant, connectedness convention, homology theory, grading, or cap-product direction.

missing_required_concrete_apis: ordinary singular cohomology compatible with the selected coefficients
manifold orientation or orientation local system at the selected theorem shape
fundamental class in the selected singular-homology theory

retry_condition: Freeze an immutable, independently reviewed source statement and every coefficient, manifold, orientation, compactness, boundary, grading, and cap-product convention; then provide or pin concrete Lean interfaces for its (co)homology, cap product, orientation, and fundamental class before elaborating and fingerprinting that exact claim.
status_boundary: Fail-closed statement record only. Null target fields expose unresolved mathematical and Lean-interface choices; they do not encode an abstract, conditional, weakened, broadened, or substituted Poincare-duality theorem.
